name: Tool & MCP Server Registry
description: Maintains a registry of all tools and MCP servers available to agents, including their capabilities, trust levels, and approval status. Every tool endpoint must be cataloged before agent use, enabling supply chain visibility and provenance tracking.
threat_addressed: Unregistered tools and MCP servers represent unknown attack surface. Without a tool registry, organizations cannot assess tool trustworthiness, track supply chain dependencies, or detect unauthorized tool additions that could introduce malicious functionality.
enforcement_mechanism: Validates that tools invoked by agents are registered in the tool registry with documented capabilities, version information, and approval status. Unregistered tools trigger alerts or blocks based on security mode.

security_outcome.pass: Tool registered in organizational registry with documented capabilities and approval status.
security_outcome.fail: Tool not registered or registry record incomplete.

display_detail: Validates that tools and MCP servers are registered with documented capabilities and approval status.
remediation_hint_template: Tool not found in registry. Register the tool using: ancilis approve-tool {tool_name}
